source.rightsEvidence: Requester attested on 2026-09-26 to clearance for full-page screenshot retention, derived design prompts, and LaunchLoom model visual-reference use. No source-owner grant was supplied or independently verified.

provenance.capture: Official-site Playwright Chromium full-page capture at the recorded viewports. Scrolled in 80 percent viewport increments to trigger lazy content, waited, and returned to top. No page content or styling was altered.
provenance.diagnostics: Observed split introduction and dual action, navy issue/service matrix, recommendation quote, sand contact-method band, team photograph split. The mobile capture was taken at 390 px. Source-specific omissions and non-transferable claims are noted in the prompt.
provenance.attribution: FLiP family-law guidance official website. The requester attested to screenshot and prompt clearance; no source-owner grant was uploaded.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A coral text half and London building photograph half create a strict split hero; two stacked actions offer immediate online or consultation routes. White nameplate navigation with slim gold and coral utility buttons before the main menu. Soft serif narrative type paired with direct small sans labels and dark navy practical text. The page sequence runs from split introduction and dual action to navy issue/service matrix to recommendation quote toward insight stories, online start action, credential footer. Architecture, team and editorial insight photographs punctuate large typography and service matrices. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.

heroGeometry.mode: A coral text half and London building photograph half create a strict split hero; two stacked actions offer immediate online or consultation routes.
heroGeometry.viewport: first-view promise, image and actionable route

navigationGeometry.mode: White nameplate navigation with slim gold and coral utility buttons before the main menu.
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact accessible navigation and visible contact path

typography.display: Soft serif narrative type paired with direct small sans labels and dark navy practical text.
typography.body: readable supporting text with visible heading hierarchy
typography.scale: one dominant opening statement, clear section headings and compact service labels

surfaces: warm sand and white; each color marks a separate decision chapter.
palette.ink: high-contrast dark text on light surfaces or light text on dark surfaces
palette.contrastIntent: preserve readable contrast; source colors are inspiration, not a copied brand palette

imageTreatment.mode: Architecture, team and editorial insight photographs punctuate large typography and service matrices.
imageTreatment.crop: site-specific focal crops at desktop and mobile
imageTreatment.focalPoint: client-owned or reviewed licensed imagery only; preserve the role of each source image rather than its subject identity

servicePresentation.pattern: Organize services by the visitor's family-law problem in a dark contrast band, with direct links and no invented specialisms.
servicePresentation.interaction: direct, functional routes for verified services only

ctaPlacement.primary: Offer one main get-started action and one consultation alternative in the hero; repeat a guided start after issue and proof sections.
ctaPlacement.secondary: a useful service, portfolio or preparation path near the opening
ctaPlacement.early: primary and secondary actions should be visible near the first promise

motion.library: CSS or a small purposeful transition only if needed
motion.reducedMotion: all copy, imagery and actions visible statically

mobileRecomposition.strategy: Place the coral text and actions before the building image, turn service matrices into stacked links, and keep contact methods large enough to tap.
rules: keep source-specific hierarchy and decision sequence
use a 390 px single-column or deliberate two-column layout without overflow
keep touch actions and form labels visible

prohibitedPatterns: Do not copy FLiP's identity, named lawyers, awards, recommendations, London location, or implied legal outcomes.
Source identity, exact wording, logos, people, photographs, fonts, badges, testimonials, numerical claims or locations as client assets.
Invented reviews, credentials, prices, guarantees, service areas, outcomes, response times or staff.
Generic SaaS cards that replace the observed composition, and decorative motion that hides service or contact information.

requiredSignatureElements.description: A new-client interpretation of the observed coral-and-photo split opening relationship, with source identity and assets excluded.

acceptanceChecks: The business kind, service and coverage claims come from verified client facts.
The first viewport has a legible promise, primary action and useful secondary route.
All signature relationships are visible in rendered desktop and mobile screenshots.
No source identity, people, images, exact copy, logos, awards, testimonials or claims have transferred.
The page has no horizontal overflow, unreadable contrast, dead calls or inaccessible form controls.
